svg.title: Two different 2011 legislative outcomes: HB475 enacted as Act 363, HB476 stayed in committee
svg.desc: Documentary source diagram. In June 2011 Louisiana Act 363 enacted a conditional 80 percent Authority, 20 percent Haspel and Davis class allocation of proceeds if non-flood assets were sold or transferred. HB476 was not enacted; a May 2011 fiscal note modeled about 3.4 million dollars annually while May 19 flood-authority minutes described a separate 3.7-million-dollar projection. Neither record proves a sale or claimant payment.
svg.metadata: Original evidence diagram created by Final Vestige Studios, November 16, 2026. Copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios. All rights reserved. Sources: Louisiana Legislature 2011 HB475 Act 363, https://www.legis.la.gov/Legis/ViewDocument.aspx?d=760740 ; HB475 bill history https://www.legis.la.gov/Legis/BillInfo.aspx?i=218062 ; HB476 bill history https://www.legis.la.gov/Legis/BillInfo.aspx?i=218063 ; Legislative Fiscal Office HB476 fiscal note https://www.legis.la.gov/Legis/ViewDocument.aspx?d=747354 ; SLFPA-East 2011-05-19 board meeting minutes, source [59] in article. Values are historical statutory rules/projections, not actual payments.
